products.product_name: Schumann V2 Pro / V1 Classic / EMF Quantum Nano Shield Sticker
red_flags: Quantum buzzword in product name (EMF Quantum Nano Shield Sticker)
Passive sticker claimed to emit frequencies — no physical mechanism
Unverifiable statistic: 94% report better sleep in week one (no methodology)
7.83 Hz wavelength is ~38,000 km — tabletop device cannot generate this
FDA disclaimer present while making health claims (sleep, focus, stress, nervous system)
Uses NASA/Earth association for credibility without substance
claims_extracted: 94% report better sleep in week one
Rewires your environment with scientifically-grounded electromagnetic frequencies
Gentle reset for the nervous system
Can significantly alter your bioenergetic state
Better sleep, reduced stress & enhanced focus
Dreams sharpen, stress eases, and focus comes easier
Sleep restores, clarity steadies, and energy renews
products.evidence_check: 0 peer-reviewed studies cited on site. 1 tangentially related RCT exists (N=40, PMC9189153) but is small, unreplicated, and not cited by the brand. FCC certification is for electronics compliance, not health efficacy. No third-party health outcome testing.
products.verdict_summary: Exploits legitimate atmospheric science (Schumann resonance) to sell devices with no plausible physical mechanism. The EMF Quantum Nano Shield Sticker — a passive sticker claiming to emit frequencies — confirms the scientific rigor of the operation. Save your money.
